machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory
scope: official 1024x1024 40-step transformer, VAE, cache-off, and ordinary Cache-DiT calibration

oracle.prompt: A vintage travel poster for CASABLANCA reading 'MEET ME AT SUNSET', bold geometric lettering.
oracle.fixture_policy: large generated tensors and images remain in /private/tmp and are not committed

cache_off.visual_result: close composition, texture, color, and exact requested text; small high-contrast letter-edge shifts
cache_off.numerical_result: not equivalent to the official BF16 trajectory

cache_dit_0_12.visual_result: all requested text and overall poster structure preserved
cache_dit_0_12.decision: recommended explicit 1024 Cache-DiT threshold; remains off by default

timing_notes: MPSGraph fragments command-buffer GPU timestamps, so integrated wall time is authoritative.
The cache-off fixture-to-PNG run was made on confirmed AC power; cached-prefix steps rose from about 8.6-8.9 seconds early to about 11.2 seconds at the tail.
An earlier cache-off loop took 479823 ms as step time rose from about 10.5 to 14.6 seconds; it produced the same 0.13211 final-latent nRMSE.
The 0.24 run followed the other long runs and started hotter. Its slower wall time despite two extra cached steps is not an algorithmic comparison with 0.12.
Fixture-driven totals exclude tokenization and text encoding because the exact official text embedding is an oracle input.
decision: close the 1024 oracle and ordinary Cache-DiT calibration phase; keep cache-off as default, recommend 0.12 when approximation is requested, reject 0.24, and retain long-horizon BF16-vs-native precision drift as the next correctness investigation
